Validate a set of correlation matrices

Source: R/statistics.R
validate_correlation_matrices.Rd

Real implementation using the shared validate_correlation_matrix() (distributions.R) - previously a stub always returning valid=TRUE.

Usage

validate_correlation_matrices(matrices, config)

Arguments

matrices

Named list keyed by method, each entry either a matrix or list(matrix=, ...) (matching run_comprehensive_correlation_analysis()'s $matrices shape).

config

Unused; kept for interface compatibility with callers.

Value

list(valid=, errors=, warnings=).
